findings.description: q-71722 permits unit literals but cannot construct their answer bank. With parameters {"2":1,"3":4}, the valid system is x-4=y; 1+y=-x, with augmented matrix [[1,-1,4],[1,1,-1]]. Only four distinct same-sign permutations exist, so bank_for_matrix raises ValueError instead of returning five choices. Negative unit input also fails; adjacent positive and negative 2 inputs succeed. This demonstrates a controlled-construction defect, not a crash in the tested CLI batch.
